lines: No boat, no witness, a thousand dinars due today. What would you do?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us of a man who borrowed a thousand dinars, saying: Allah is enough as a witness.
When the day came, he found no boat. So he put the dinars and a letter in a piece of wood... and entrusted it to Allah, in the sea.
On the other shore, the lender found a piece of wood. He cut it open... and there was his money.
Can't keep a promise with your own hands? Keep it with Allah.
